findings.quote: Whether it is climate change or artificial intelligence, there is always the temptation to say that our generation is being confronted by issues that our predecessors could not possibly have imagined while dealing with the world they would not recognise.
findings.rationale: Explicitly frames AI as a challenge for collective UN action, with inclusive participation rather than exclusive great-power or corporate control.

findings.quote: AI can improve lives, boost growth and productivity, provide revolutionary breakthroughs in healthcare and other fields.
findings.rationale: Discusses AI opportunities, frontier development risks, an alleged agent intrusion, and national standards and international action to shape development.
